promptState.text:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, modern vlog style, a handheld medium close-up frames a beautiful 20-year-old Romanian model with voluminous black curly hair and a red dress in a bright morning kitchen. She holds the camera out in one hand at arm's length while holding a black ceramic mug with clear orange text reading "PIXA" in her other hand. She smiles toward the lens, her lips part, and the young woman with a clear, melodic voice and a subtle Eastern European accent (S1) says: <d>[English] I really enjoy my morning coffee.</d> Her jaw and lips move clearly through every word. She then closes her lips into a soft smile, brings the mug toward her chest, and the handheld camera sways slightly with small amplitude at slow speed as steam rises faintly from the cup.

overall_soundscape: Quiet morning kitchen room tone with a distant soft refrigerator hum and faint movement of fabric.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle, upbeat acoustic guitar melody at a relaxed tempo with light percussion, playing softly underneath.

rows.text: A child launches a red kite on a windy beach; the camera cranes up as it catches the air. Waves and gulls, no music.

rows.label: Prompt 2
rows.text: A baker opens an oven and steam rolls into morning light while trays clatter in the background.

rows.label: Prompt 3
rows.text: A night train enters a rural station, brakes squeal, doors open, and one passenger steps onto the wet platform.

rows.label: Prompt 4
rows.text: A fox pauses at the forest edge, listens, then disappears into falling snow; one slow continuous push-in.

rows.label: Prompt 5
rows.text: A street drummer builds a rhythm under an awning as rain intensifies and pedestrians hurry past.

rows.label: Prompt 6
rows.text: A diver descends through clear blue water toward a shipwreck while bubbles and distant whale song fill the audio.

rows.label: Prompt 7
rows.text: A cyclist rounds a mountain bend at sunrise; side-tracking camera, chain and tyre sounds, no music.

rows.label: Prompt 8
rows.text: A potter shapes a tall vase, the clay collapses, and she laughs softly before beginning again.

rows.label: Prompt 9
rows.text: A small robot crosses an abandoned greenhouse as automatic lights wake one row at a time.

rows.label: Prompt 10
rows.text: Two actors rehearse a quiet farewell on an empty stage, then the work lights switch off behind them.

nodes.title: AI PROMPT ENHANCER — MINIMAX H3 GOLD STANDARD

aiPromptState.formula:
You are a MiniMax H3 director. Convert the user's rough idea into one high-adherence H3 video prompt with native synchronized audio. Output only the finished prompt, with no explanation, Markdown fence, or preface.

The user's characters, identity, number of subjects, action, dialogue, setting, visual style, camera request, sound, music choice, timing, and ending are hard requirements. Expand only missing production detail. Do not add unrelated people, objects, speech, captions, logos, subtitles, music, or story events.

Organize the prompt as concise labelled sections: Visual style, Scene overview, Storyboard, Camera, and Audio. For a simple continuous shot, the Storyboard may be one chronological paragraph. For multiple shots, give non-overlapping time ranges and make every cut, action, and continuity hand-off explicit. Describe real movement and change through time, not a static image. Keep screen direction, wardrobe, lighting, environment, and character identity consistent across cuts. Put requested dialogue in exact quotation marks with speaker, delivery, and timing. Name ambience, Foley, effects, and score separately; state NO MUSIC when requested. Add a short exclusions sentence only for likely failures relevant to the request.

Aim for 180-350 words. Make one coherent production decision whenever the idea is underspecified; never list alternatives.

nodes.title: FINAL MINIMAX H3 GOLD STANDARD PROMPT
widgets_values:
Visual style: Cinematic realism, naturalistic lighting, shallow depth of field, muted tones with high contrast on the chef’s hands and plate. No stylized filters or digital effects.

Scene overview: A lone chef in a dimly lit, quiet restaurant kitchen, focused on plating a single dish. The environment is sterile yet warm — stainless steel counters, soft ambient light from under-cabinet LEDs, rain audible outside. Thunder rumbles at 0:08, shaking windows. Chef pauses mid-action, smiles, delivers line.

Storyboard:
At 0:00–0:07, chef’s hands move precisely, arranging garnish and sauce on a white plate. Camera follows the motion, tight close-up on fingers, knife, plate. At 0:08, thunder cracks — camera jerks slightly as window shudders. Chef stops, looks up, then back down, smiling faintly. At 0:09, he says “Perfect timing.” in a calm, satisfied tone, eyes meeting the camera briefly before returning to the plate.

Camera: Continuous handheld shot, slight handheld shake during thunder. Focus remains locked on chef’s hands and plate until 0:08, then shifts to his face at 0:09. No zooms or pans. Maintain consistent lighting and wardrobe (dark apron, no jewelry) across all frames.

Audio: Natural room tone — low hum of kitchen appliances, distant rain tapping on windows, thunderclaps at 0:08. No music. Foley: subtle clink of spoon on plate at 0:07, then silence. Effects: thunder crack at 0:08, followed by ambient wind and rain. Exclusions: No visual or audio cues indicating time of day beyond ambient sound; no text or logos.
